name: Narita Shinri
source:
Hobbies: Morning exercise
Skills: Seeing and accurately calculating down a girl's bust size just from the top of their clothes
Likes: Coffee, big boobs
Dislikes: Fried insects

The protagonist and one of the six Crowns, the leaders of The Academy. He is the only male Crown and has been invited to The Academy as a transfer student by the Chairman [url=/c17305]Kurofune[/url]. His past is shrouded in mystery, and he hides within him an incredible power. He challenges the foundations of The Academy over and over again, dismissing the challenges that the other Crowns set out for him.

He possesses an unshakable and iron will, and acts as though the world revolves around him, though he does have a clear sense of respect for that which he accredits value. Surprisingly, he's not very detail-oriented, as shown by his refusal to use instruction manuals.

Has lived abroad for years, resulting in his somewhat quirky personality. He's viewed as a bit of an unusual man, but is largely unfazed by how others see him. He goes crazy over large boobs, and especially enjoys groping them.

"I've surpassed all suffering, followed the path of fate's string... And have finally arrived at my promised stage."

[Edited from [url=https://hello.nekonyansoft.com/chara.html]official English page[/url]]
